links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses on low back pain versus recommended 6th grade level
links.effect: Readability of responses from all three chatbots was above the recommended 6th grade level (p < 0.001); Perplexity had higher quality, reliability scores (EQIP, JAMA, modified DISCERN, GQS; p < 0.001).
links.quote: It was determined that the readability of the responses given by all AI chatbots was higher than the recommended 6th grade readability level (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLM chatbots (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) assessing the quality, readability, and reliability of answers to low back pain search terms without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
